The District of Columbia has seen fluctuating population growth over the past few decades. ## Life in the District
The District of Columbia has seen fluctuating population growth over the past few decades. Its population declined throughout the 1990s, when crime rates were at their peak, but has recovered since then. While unemployment in the district has also been falling, it still had a high poverty rate in recent years.

Crime rates in the U.S. have decreased compared to previous years, although many Americans still perceive crime as an important issue.
